functions.name: ScreenPointToRay
functions.doc: The ray from `camera` through `point`, in window pixels from the top-left of its target.

returns.doc: Whether there is a ray: false with no renderer, no such camera, or a point outside the camera's viewport.

parameters.name: ray
parameters.doc: The ray; the default ray when there is none.

functions.name: WorldToScreenPoint
functions.doc: Where `point`, in world space, appears on `camera`'s target, in window pixels from its top-left.

returns.doc: Whether it appears: false with no renderer, no such camera, or a point behind the camera.

parameters.name: screenPoint
parameters.doc: The point; zero when it does not appear.

functions.name: CameraAt
functions.doc: The camera drawn last at `point` of `window`, in window pixels from its top-left: the highest-order enabled camera in the active scene whose viewport holds it.

returns.doc: Whether there is one: false when there is none or no renderer.

parameters.name: camera
parameters.doc: The camera entity; no entity (the default Entity, C#'s Entity.None) when there is none.

functions.name: GetWorldBounds
functions.doc: The world-space box around the drawn meshes of `entity` and its children, now.

returns.doc: Whether there is one: false with no renderer, an entity not alive, or no mesh to bound (no MeshRenderer, or a mesh that does not resolve).

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.doc: The box; the default box when there is none.

functions.name: Stats
functions.doc: What the renderer did in the last drawn frame; zeros before the first.

returns.doc: Whether the app has a renderer.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.doc: The counts; zero with no renderer.

functions.name: SpawnModel
functions.doc: Spawns `model` into the active scene as SpawnModel does, under `parent` unless it is no entity: recorded, so it takes effect when the system returns.

returns.doc: Whether it spawned: false when the app has no store, the model is stale or the parent is not alive.

parameters.name: model
parameters.doc: The model's handle, packed as Fenrir.Assets packs one (generation high, index low).

parameters.name: parent
parameters.doc: The entity to spawn under; no entity (Entity.None in C#) for none.

parameters.name: root
parameters.doc: The model's root entity; no entity (the default Entity, C#'s Entity.None) when nothing was spawned.
